qa_pairs.question: How does the legal framework under the Customs Act, 1969, facilitate the interaction between the recovery of taxes and the issuance of show-cause notices?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the Customs Act, 1969, the procedural framework for handling tax matters involves specific documentation: Section 83A, read with Section 83B(2), governs the issuance of show-cause notices [0], while the subsequent process for formal tax recovery (dabinama) is also standardized under the same sections [1].
